text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the conflict between Tamamo Cross
and Oguri
Cap glows white-hot...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ahem, aren't you forgetting somebody?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoooa!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Go, Creek, gooo! Dat's da way! Hit 'em
where it
hurts!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek is in the lead. And she's
holding onto
it. The Kikuka Sho is
herrrrs!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Despite being a last-minute replacement
for a
withdrawal, Super Creek has slid
right to victory
in the final G1 race of
the Classics! What an
unbelievable win!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for keeping all my sweet
little fans
waiting. I know I took a little
longer than Oguri to
bloom, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Next up, I'll be heading to the Arima
Kinen.
Tamtam, Oguri, I'd love to join
you both there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Creek, you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way back from the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So, Oguri, how've things been lately?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Lately? Well...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've been very hungry. Very.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, that's always the case with you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The bigger the race, the more energy I
need.
That's what gets my hunger going.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And now that Creek's going to be
joining us, I
feel an even more intense
hunger... I could really
go for Toki's
meat and potato stew or some of
Ine's
beef sinew skewers...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's go and grab something to eat.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hold up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap saunters off into the labyrinth
that is
Kyoto's famed food district.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One evening a few days later...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Dammit... Not again...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I mean, not like this is totally outta left
field for
me, but still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a plate of uneaten food in front of
her,
Tamamo Cross grits her teeth.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...I'm strugglin' to eat again. See, lately...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross explains that slowly over
time, the
portions we worked so hard to
increase have
shrunk down again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I'm not entirely surprised.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And the box lunch I ate before today's
race was
extra tasty. Maybe that played
a part too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's what she said after the autumn
Tenno Sho.
If I read between the lines...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She must not usually find meals to be
especially
tasty. And if she's falling back
into those old
habits again...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri and I sure are opposites. She's
eating just
fine—hell, she's eaten more
than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's the difference between us... The
tougher
the race, the more she eats, but
my appetite only
dies down as the
stakes get higher.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: If this keeps up, I'll...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The less she eats, the greater our
disadvantage
will be. That said...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Shapin' up? If anythin', things are goin' downhill, dont'cha think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The current situation's different from
when her
body was underdeveloped.
Tamamo Cross's
hunger is the source of
her strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The more crucial a race is, the more
intensely her
body hungers for the win.
In a sense, this is an
inevitable change.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So my body's preppin' itself before it
leaps into
the fray... Still...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If Oguri keeps chowin' down, she'll just
get
stronger 'n stronger...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And I can't do that. The more I try 'n
bulk up, the
worse things get...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There's no light at the end of this tunnel.
And I
know that on account of how well I
know Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm not winnin' this race... No doubt
about it, she's
gonna get better 'n
better, and I'll be left in the
dust.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But there's gotta be some way outta this, right? Some way I can get ahead of Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fighting fire with fire—or food with food in Oguri's case—probably won't do us any good. That's her strategy, not ours. Which means...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: My hunger... Yeah, I got a real hunger in me. That's my strength. And it's the one area Oguri hasn't got me beat.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So I just gotta hold my own and keep on

sharpenin' my skills till the race. But
how...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She goes quiet as she becomes lost in
thought.
The silence continues until...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: DAT'S IT!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Think 'bout it... Don'tcha think I've got it
pretty
good right now? A little too
good?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
When times are good, I go on defense. I
wanna
protect what I have from the bad
times. But what
if there's nothing to
defend?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's it. There's no other way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross's eyes glimmer subtly, as
if to
suggest she's made up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm White Lightning. But ya
know, the
thing about lightnin' is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It only flashes bright for a sec, right? It
vanishes
after that. So...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Me runnin' like Oguri—pacin' myself and
savin' my
energy for the long haul—is
kinda nuts, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No way am I gonna win coppin' someone
else's
style.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I don't needa think about my racing career. In fact, if I do, I lose my edge. Only way I can stay sharp is by not thinkin' about what's up ahead.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I just needa focus on the moment. I've
got one,
maybe two more races with
Oguri in me. And for
those races...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I wanna see what happens when I put it all on the line. My resolve, my racing career—everything.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If I do that, I think I can do it. I can
become the
fastest, strongest White
Lightning I can
be—someone who can fly
past Oguri in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I've never had nothin' to my name. And
if I can't
get this one thing I want most,
right when I'm
finally ready to treat
myself, well... that'd be one
lousy joke.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So I'm tossin' everythin' else aside 'n
stakin' my
whole life on what happens
this winter! 'Cause if
we do that, then
maybe, just maybe...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You bet I am. Dad said he don't mind me
quittin'
once I've done all I can.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya gotta know when to call it quits,
y'know. And
for me, it's this year's Arima
Kinen. Till then, I'll
do what I gotta do,
but after that, it's family time
for me...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
How's that sound? It'll be the end of my
time with
you, too... but are ya still
willin' to go for the win
with me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
When people look back on this time in
the future,
I want them all to say the
same thing. "Tamamo
Cross was stronger
than Oguri Cap."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And there's somethin' else I wanna believe too. I wanna believe that my life as a runner was the best because it ended too soon!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... That's the peak I got my sights
on.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So what if it kills me? I just don't want
any regrets!
So please, I'm beggin' ya,
help me reach my peak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's just no way... I can possibly
refuse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross is ready to stake her
entire
existence on the coming season.
All I can say is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I owe ya big time, Trainer! All right, let's
make
beatin' her our goal 'n really go for
it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That win is all I need. Nothin' more,
nothin' less.
And I'm gonna get that win,
even if it's the last
thing I do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I put Tamamo Cross on an
intense
training schedule.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... It's still not enough—I need more! More power... More hunger!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I want it... I'll do anythin' for it... For the
power to
go past her—to overtake her!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, wheeze... How many days... How many days till our next race?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, I can keep going! I needa
squeeze every
second of training I can
before the big
smackdown!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross is desperate to improve,
and I'm
desperately trying to keep her in
check... We'll
keep pushing though,
right up to the breaking
point, to surge
even further ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The searing glow of White Lightning
grows
brighter by the day—a light that
shines with
Tamamo Cross's very
lifeforce.
